purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Bonchari Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: This form's second page prints upside-down (rotated 180 degrees); rendered at 500 DPI and rotated 180 degrees for legible digit-level confirmation of the TOTAL row. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered (rotation-corrected) page image. Column identity (Odinga / Ruto / Mwaure / Wajackoyah) was cross-checked against the same form's page-1 header row before this row was accepted. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (BONCHARI, code 261) was read from the visible 'CON 261' banner marker and the page 1 'Constituency: BONCHARI / Code: 261' header block.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: The printed Registered Voters figure (64,630) matches the governed P23 ward-summed registered-voters denominator (KDA-VOTERS-CON-261-2022) exactly, and Rejected Ballots (480) is individually clear. However, the row's own four candidate cells (27,960 + 12,127 + 79 + 159 = 40,325) do not sum to the printed Total Valid Votes (40,848), a substantially larger 523-vote discrepancy than the single-digit-scale arithmetic mismatches recorded elsewhere in this Atlas. All digits were independently re-read at 500 DPI on the rotation-corrected page, and the column headers (Odinga / Samoei-Ruto / Mwaure / Wajackoyah) were cross-checked against the form's own page-1 header row, with identical results both times, so this is judged a genuine printed-form arithmetic error rather than a legibility, column-order, or transcription issue. Per the extraction contract's invariant that arithmetic-mismatch rows remain promotion-blocked even when their component integers are individually source-verified, this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence.
